spans.s: tola, tolā, cf. Telugu-Kannaḍa tulā (CITD), weight of a rupee, taken as the unit of the system of weights; fixed at 180 grains troy by the British; also called suvarṇa (JNSI, Vol. XVI, p. 46).
tola , also spelt tolaka; 80 ratis in weight; same as suvarṇa.
tolaka, same as tola; equal to 2 śānas or 80 ratis; also called kola, draṅkṣaṇa, badara, kṣudraka, vaṭaka, etc. (JNSI, Vol. XVI, pp. 41, 44).
tolaka , same as kola or tola; 80 ratis in weight.
tol-ŏṭṭu (SITI), Tamil; a fee probably connected with hides and skins.
